entities.name: Lawrence Clay-Bey

entities.summary: Lawrence Marvin Clay-Bey is an American former professional boxer who fought at heavyweight. As an amateur he was a two-time winner of the United States National Championships as well as a bronze medalist at the 1995 World Championships, all in the super heavyweight division.
